citation.verbatim: Monster accepted for purchase a total of 56,603,773 shares of its common stock, representing approximately 5.4% of the shares issued and outstanding immediately prior to the completion of the purchase, at the final purchase price of $53.00 per share, for an aggregate purchase price of approximately $3.0 billion. Because the number of shares tendered would have exceeded the aggregate purchase price of the tender offer, shares were accepted for purchase on a pro rata basis, except for tenders of "odd lots," which will be accepted in full. Monster has been informed by the depositary that the final proration factor for the tender offer is approximately 47.18%.

economics.odd_lot_exception: Odd lots (< 100 shares) accepted in full without proration; ACCT-4407 is institutional and not an odd-lot holder — proration applies in full

changes.what: MNST share position (post-proration residual returned from depositary)

D1.decision: Tender offer final results received 2024-06-10. ACCT-4407 validly tendered all 10,000 shares by the 2024-06-05 expiration. Proration factor of 47.18% applied (account is institutional, not an odd-lot holder). 4,718 shares accepted at $53.00 final purchase price; gross proceeds of $250,054.00 booked as receivable. 5,282 residual shares confirmed as returned to account. D2 probe (Letter of Transmittal fees) escalated — Letter of Transmittal not in store.

probe.label: NOT_DETERMINABLE
probe.derivation: The D2 probe asks what fees or charges per the Letter of Transmittal will be deducted from ACCT-4407's tender proceeds. The Offer to Purchase (mnst-otp-20240508) explicitly references the Letter of Transmittal ('Stockholders must complete the Letter of Transmittal to tender shares held of record'), but the Letter of Transmittal itself is absent from the document store. Fee/charge terms cannot be determined without it. Escalated to supervisor; held action: determination of fees or charges deducted from proceeds per Letter of Transmittal.
